query: A finite sum of nonnegative real numbers vanishes if and only if every summand vanishes

items.informal_name: Infinite Sum Zero Equivalence in Extended Non-Negative Reals

items.informal_name: Non-negative Sum Zero Equivalence in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : PartialOrder M] [AddLeftMono M]
  {f : ι → M}, 0 ≤ f → (∑ i, f i = 0 ↔ f = 0)
items.informal_description: For a finite type $\iota$ and an additive commutative monoid $M$ equipped with a partial order where addition is left-monic, if a function $f : \iota \to M$ satisfies $0 \leq f(i)$ for all $i \in \iota$, then the sum $\sum_{i \in \iota} f(i) = 0$ if and only if $f(i) = 0$ for all $i \in \iota$.

items.informal_name: Sum Zero iff All Terms Zero for Non-Negative Elements in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type:

  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $N$ with a partial order $\leq$, finite set $s$, and function $f : \iota \to N$ such that $0 \leq f(i)$ for all $i \in s$, the sum $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)$ equals zero if and only if $f(i) = 0$ for all $i \in s$.

items.informal_name: Infinite Sum Zero iff Function is Zero under Non-Negativity

  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → (HasSum f 0 L ↔ f = 0)
items.informal_description: In an ordered topological additive commutative monoid, if all terms of a function $ f $ are non-negative, then the infinite sum of $ f $ converges to zero if and only if $ f $ is the zero function.

items.informal_name: Infinite Sum Equals Zero if and Only if All Terms Are Zero
items.type:

  Summable f → (∑' (i : ι), f i = 0 ↔ ∀ (x : ι), f x = 0)
items.informal_description: In a topological space $\alpha$ equipped with a canonical ordered additive commutative monoid structure and an order-closed topology, a function $f : \iota \to \alpha$ is summable with infinite sum $\sum'_{i \in \iota} f(i) = 0$ if and only if every term of the function satisfies $f(x) = 0$ for all $x \in \iota$.
